listing.name: Xenogears / xenogears-decomp-port (Blizz127)
listing.summary: Explore the experimental Linux Xenogears port and prepare a permitted copy with your own USA disc.

steps.title: Prepare the reviewed original files
steps.instruction: The published r5 route requires Xenogears USA SLUS-00664 Disc 1 as a 718738272-byte raw BIN plus SLUS_006.64, field.bin, menu.bin, shop_menu.bin, member_change_menu.bin and world_map.bin extracted from your own disc. An ISO is not equivalent. Follow the upstream extraction guide; no extractor is run by discovery and the runtime checks missing or different files.

steps.title: Use the existing upstream launcher
steps.instruction: For an existing copy you are permitted to use, run xenogears.sh with the prepared data folder on the first start; it remembers the folder. Keep its lib directory and OS launcher because the wrapper supplies the library environment. Preserve ~/.config/xenogears-port and ~/.local/share/xenogears-port (or the selected XDG locations), including cards and quick checkpoints. Portcove does not register the shell script, adopt files or replace this runtime.

warnings: The published r5 binary expressly includes about 6.6 KB of transcribed retail tables and upstream contributor code outside the project MIT grant. A statement about future v0.6.0 source is not a repaired released package.

This preview has known on-foot battle crashes and an unfinished route beyond map 15. Runtime replacement, external backup and checkpoint compatibility remain with you/upstream; no native gameplay or real-save acceptance is established.

listing.download_block_reason: Published r5 includes transcribed retail tables and code from an upstream decompilation with no published license; its parent MIT grant excludes that work. Resolve permission for the affected package scope or supply a reviewed released replacement that removes it. Future-source fixes do not establish a repaired downloadable artifact. Permitted existing copies remain external.
